track.title: Homayun: Zangule
track.notes: Open: the suite's finalis is unsettled: votes split between G and the 4th above it, and Daramad I votes the 4th. Vote kept.

just_intervals.note: measured octave minus 1200 ¢, register to register

progression.narrative: The performance opens on F#3 and dwells most on C# in Zangule. The line peaks at E4 (330.6 Hz) at 0:25.9. It closes on F#3, not the tonic (E4 → B3 → E3 → F#3 → B3 → F#3).
